_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for core-dev model pins. Two tiers; each agent maps to a tier. Each tier carries an `alias` (what goes into agent .md frontmatter) and a `reference_model` (the concrete model the alias resolves to on the first-party API). Edit a tier, then run `python3 bench/model-pins/check.py --apply` to propagate the alias to frontmatter. bench/lib/capture.py reads this file at runtime (no second copy). check.py also verifies bench/prices.json has a price row for each reference_model. Frontmatter carries the ALIAS, not the concrete id: an id is provider-specific (on Bedrock it becomes a region-prefixed inference profile or an ARN), and pinning one there makes the pin unresolvable off the first-party API -- Claude Code then silently inherits the parent model instead of erroring. See ADR-0020. NOTE: frontmatter still accepts no runtime indirection (${VAR}/central-config unsupported), and the global CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL env var would flatten both tiers to one model -- so frontmatter stays literal and is kept in sync by check.py.
